title: Are mutants a valid substitute for real faults in software testing?

evidence.claim: In code testing, mutant detection correlates with real fault detection, independently of code coverage (357 real faults, 5 applications).
evidence.quote: The results show a statistically significant correlation between mutant detection and real fault detection, independently of code coverage.
Our experiments used 357 real faults in 5 open-source applications that comprise a total of 321,000 lines of code.

title: Adding Error Bars to Evals: A Statistical Approach to Language Model Evaluations

evidence.claim: Evaluations are experiments but the evals literature has ignored experiment analysis from other sciences.
evidence.quote: Fundamentally, evaluations are experiments; but the literature on evaluations has largely ignored the literature from other sciences on experiment analysis and planning.

title: MILE: A Mutation Testing Framework of In-Context Learning Systems

evidence.claim: MILE proposes mutation operators and mutation scores for ICL test sets.
evidence.quote: we propose several mutation operators specialized for ICL demonstrations, as well as corresponding mutation scores for ICL test sets.

title: Non-Determinism of "Deterministic" LLM System Settings in Hosted Environments

evidence.claim: LLM accuracy varies by up to 15% across runs under nominally deterministic settings.
evidence.quote: Experiments reveal accuracy variations of up to 15% across runs
